images.caption: Figure 2:(a) Traditional advertising workflow vs. (b) AdProducer.AdProducer automates product research and creative planning, enabling rapid advertising video creation from a short brief.

Figure 3:Inference trajectory of AdProducer on a benchmark brief.The agent verifies product facts through text searches (T1–T2), selects visual references through image searches (T3–T4), and finally writes a selling-point-driven, three-shot storyboard (T5). Only the storyboard and reference images (P1–P3) are passed to a frozen reference-to-video generator. Prompt and storyboard details are inSec.A.2.

Figure 5:AdCreation-Bench overview.(a) 305 briefs over eight domains, covering a broad time span from 1836 to 2026.
(b) Example items across different categories and release times, each with a brief excerpt, key product facts and the selling point to demonstrate.

Figure 6:Qualitative comparison across video generators and product categories.Red: direct-prompting baselines; blue: AdProducer; green: official product images. Grounded in product research, AdProducer depicts each product as it really looks, presents verified facts as legible on-screen text, and unfolds the selling point across multiple shots with varied compositions. Detailed analysis inSec.6.4.
